variable_or_assertion: CLAIMS_RESTART_MODE (must be write or read) + CLAIMS_RESTART_TENANT
detail: System.InvalidOperationException: Explicit write/read restart mode required; exclude from ordinary suite. The test is one half of a two-process restart check and throws unless an outer driver sets the mode. It is not a lane Mongo variable and the lane must not set it for an ordinary run. Same single failure in Q103 (README.md:74, 128/129, by design). Fails in 3 ms, before any product code runs.

variable_or_assertion: Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, response.Response.StatusCode) — Expected: Created, Actual: ServiceUnavailable (when it fails)
detail: Known survivor F-Q205-2, kept as its own row. Result depends on what runs beside it, on the SAME mongod and the SAME build: full seven-folder run = PASSED (1/1); Loads folder alone = FAILED (1/1, 32/33); the test alone = FAILED (4/4). So single-member vs 3-node is not what flips it here. Not classifiable from outside: it could be a product defect (commit retry does not recover) that the full run masks, or a test-isolation defect. Unverified lead: the test arms a server-wide failCommand fail point (times: 1) on commitTransaction; in a full run a parallel test class on the same mongod can consume it. Test and service code were not changed or instrumented (protected).
